_note: The FLWO 60-inch's atmospheric dispersion corrector: Alpaca switch/0 (tracking) and rotator/0, rotator/1 (prisms A, B) over the two prism motors on one serial line (docs/adc.md).
The ADC belongs to the telescope and serves both instruments (TRES, FAST); 'instrument' only picks the band of the refraction model.
Hardware is NOT allowed: allow_hardware stays false until every item under 'Confirm on the mountain' in docs/adc.md is checked.
Then: allow_hardware true here AND --hardware on the command line, on the computer the motors' serial cable is plugged into.
port.device is a placeholder for that computer's serial device.
telescope: the TCSGO server's Telescope (sites/flwo60/tcsgo.json listens on 11140): the only input. Every address is a 127.0.0.1 placeholder.
deflection: legacy_table (the legacy daemon's zenith-distance table). The refraction model's max_dispersion_arcsec (3.8) is a fit to that table, unconfirmed; the FAST band is a placeholder.
trust_counter false: after every start the motors must be homed (Action Home) before tracking; home_wait (s) are the legacy daemon's waits.
update_interval (2 s) is the legacy cadence; deadband (deg) replaces its 1-2 deg parallactic-angle threshold.
